description.value: Invermere Liquor Store is a locally operated retail alcohol shop situated in front of the Canadian Tire on the main commercial strip in Invermere. It stocks a wide selection of beer, wine, and spirits including a dedicated cold room for chilled beer, coolers, and ciders, and carries a notable range of BC wines with knowledgeable staff on hand. For touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley, it is a convenient stop to resupply for an evening at camp.
